## Advanced uses / tutorials

This vignette points to **tutorials** detailing how to use the [deepSTRAPP] package beyond the **simple use-case** presented in the README file and also available here: `vignette("main_tutorial")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/main_tutorial.html)

They present more **advanced usages** and provide explanations on available arguments and interpretations of results of deepSTRAPP.

### Full deepSTRAPP workflows on different types of data

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp;Full deepSTRAPP workflow for **continuous** trait data: `vignette("deepSTRAPP_continuous_data")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/deepSTRAPP_continuous_data.html)

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp;Full deepSTRAPP workflow for **categorical** trait data with 3 levels: `vignette("deepSTRAPP_categorical_3lvl_data")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/deepSTRAPP_categorical_3lvl_data.html)

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp;Full deepSTRAPP workflow for **biogeographic** range data: `vignette("deepSTRAPP_biogeographic_data")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/deepSTRAPP_biogeographic_data.html)

<br>
For a full deepSTRAPP workflow on categorical trait data with **2 levels**, please refer to the [main tutorial](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/main_tutorial.html).

### Explore options for trait evolution

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp;Model evolution of **continuous** trait data on a time-calibrated phylogeny: `vignette("model_continuous_trait_evolution")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/model_continuous_trait_evolution.html)

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp;Model evolution of **categorical** trait data on a time-calibrated phylogeny: `vignette("model_categorical_trait_evolution")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/model_categorical_trait_evolution.html)

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CF;&nbsp;&nbsp;Model evolution of **biogeographic** range data on a time-calibrated phylogeny: `vignette("model_biogeographic_range_evolution")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/model_biogeographic_range_evolution.html)

### Explore options for BAMM

Model **diversification dynamics** with BAMM within deepSTRAPP: `vignette("model_diversification_dynamics")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/model_diversification_dynamics.html)

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CB;&nbsp;&nbsp;Detail the extent of possible parametrization.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CB;&nbsp;&nbsp;Explain evaluation plots.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CB;&nbsp;&nbsp;Show options for shift location on `deepSTRAPP::plot_BAMM_rates()`: index, MAP, MSC.

### Explore the STRAPP test options

Type of STRAPP tests: **two-tailed** vs. **one-tailed**: `vignette("explore_STRAPP_test_types")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/explore_STRAPP_test_types.html)

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CB;&nbsp;&nbsp;Continuous: "negative" or "positive" correlation.

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CB;&nbsp;&nbsp;Binary with hypothesis: (A > B) vs. (B > A).

&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&#x25CB;&nbsp;&nbsp;Multinominal: Hypotheses for all post hoc tests.
 
### Plot rates through time (RTT)

Explore options for plotting diversification **rates through time** in relation to trait data: `vignette("plot_rates_through_time")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/plot_rates_through_time.html)

### Cut phylogenies

Cut different types of **(mapped) phylogenies** for a given focal-time: phylogeny, contMap, densityMap, BAMM_object: `vignette("cut_phylogenies")`. [Link](https://github.com/MaelDore/deepSTRAPP/blob/master/doc/cut_phylogenies.html)

<br>
